name: Ereb
source:
Has the familiar and beloved Sovyonok camp, harboring many theories and dark sides, finally malfunctioned? Thousands or perhaps millions of years have not been kind to the protagonist of this story, Semyon. During his entire time staying here, he has managed to do a great deal... And all of those actions have changed something within the very system of Sovyonok itself, resulting in him being [deleted].

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3706434895]Steam[/url]]
translation:
熟悉而受人喜爱的、蕴藏着许多理论和阴暗面的苏维约克阵营终于崩溃了吗？几千年甚至几百万年对这个故事的主角谢苗来说并不友善。在他留在这里的整个时间里，他成功地做了很多事情……所有这些行动都改变了索维诺克本身系统内的某些东西，导致他成为[deleted]。

[来自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3706434895]Steam[/url]]
